name: verified_rust
description: Native verified Rust workspace build and test capabilities (opt in).

tools.name: build_workspace
tools.description: Build the Rust workspace and independently verify success. Use scope=workspace. Only a committed runtime receipt proves the configured build succeeded.

tools.name: run_workspace_tests
tools.description: Run and independently verify tests for the Rust workspace. Use scope=workspace. Only a committed runtime receipt proves the declared test check passed.
